verbatim: The agent is supposed to own the decision to inspect its own communication channel. Popit should provide the capability, not perform the action on the agent's behalf.
observed: Toast.start() ran a daemon thread that called run_probe() every four seconds, so the cua-chat driver captured Freebuff and _harness_regions() measured three image crops on a timer that no agent and no mission had started. The window reported `textbox probed` while Freebuff itself said `Mission stopped`, and the probe never extracted the composer's text: it returned image paths and digests. No MCP tool existed for reading the composer, and a reply was refused `harness-unprobed` unless a capture had happened within eight seconds.
correction: The timer no longer probes: `_loop` repairs the archive only. `/mcp` carries `freebuff.composer.read`, which an agent calls with its own name and task; cua.py answers it with a new `composer_read` action that reads the composer field through UI Automation TextPattern (placeholder separated by HelpText), falls back to the composer crop as an image content block, and never focuses, types, presses a key or submits. The receipt is appended to runlogs/toast/composer-reads.jsonl and the desk reports `read by <agent>`; the freshness refusal and its gate were removed, so no shell timer decides when an agent may communicate. tools/gate.py carries composer-read-is-agent-initiated.
